[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive states. Never interpret rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. The boundary object is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a separate utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. A01, A02 and A03 introduce no boundary-marginal substitution.

[context:qualifications] The maintained household scope is bounded utility, continuous resources and a general compact iid-income law. P03's two-point distribution establishes primitive consistency only and does not restrict the general law. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only assumptions and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction; actual actions lie in [0,z], with shares auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, proves uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points and uniform value iteration, and bounds value using inf U and sup U over all nonnegative consumption. H03 proves ordinary real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility, and satisfies c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, impatience, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset or finite-state premise enters H01–H04.

[context:qualifications] P01 proves budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. Equality and borrowing feasibility are separate components; original prices satisfy R=1+r, and the next-resource identity was separately proved. P02 finite-cap continuity fixes the cap and labor floor, treats r=0 separately and includes the zero-cap case without dividing by the cap. Its natural-cap branch requires r>0, gives -r*phi_nat=-w*l_min and effective income w*(l-l_min), and asserts no continuity of the raw natural borrowing limit through zero. P03's consistency witness establishes neither optimization nor stationarity nor equilibrium.

[context:qualifications] M02B's lifetime interpretation is an absolutely convergent series of expected flows under finite-history product laws, covering admitted measurable full-history feasible plans. No literal infinite-product lifetime random variable is constructed. Translation to the original budget remains conditional on normalization from OriginalPrices. Under that bridge, the normalized affine income intercept equals -(R-1)*phi. S05 and S06 retain their normalized-coordinate interpretation; A01 does not remove this qualification. A02 explicitly requires normalization for its original-coordinate accounting identities. Both A03 interfaces acquire an original debt-limit interpretation only with compatibility and nonnegativity.

dimension_assessments.summary: The new export proves continuity of the actual integral on ImpatientPrices m × ℝ, covering independent price and shift variation. The required existing graph theorem remains unchanged.

Integrability justifies S(q,phi)=M(q)-phi. Composing accepted continuity of M with the first projection and subtracting the second proves joint continuity. The reused proof combines local common support, uniform policy convergence and a bounded continuous clipped test.

A(z) is shifted saving from current resources; next resources use fresh labor. Subtracting phi gives net assets. Economic interpretation requires phi≥0 and intercept=-(R-1)phi; keeping phi independent retains debt information that normalized prices lose at R=1.

Inspected A93 printed 39–40/original PDF 40–41, Proposition 5; A94 printed 667–670/PDF 10–13, especially (8) on 668; C90 printed 548/PDF 7, Proposition 2.4(i),(18). They support law/mean continuity and aggregation; the compact-support proof is a reconstruction.

Premises are bounded BASIC utility, positive-state smoothness, eventual bounded RRA, essential income endpoints and strict impatience. D03's uniform bounds are derived locally, not added as assumptions.
No continuity, invariant law or finite moment is assumed as a conclusion. The price domain is nonempty: R=w=1 and intercept=0 are admissible and strictly impatient for BASIC beta.
The diff appends one public theorem and audit commands; accepted graph and analytic bodies remain unchanged. The proof follows the authorized H06/D03/S06/A02 route.

Resources remain NNReal and labor has an arbitrary probability law on a compact interval with essential distinct endpoints. Product histories supply iid draws; no grid, density or finite-support restriction appears.

The added theorem and reused mean-continuity proof invoke no boundary marginal. Their compact interval includes zero through policy feasibility and continuity. Inherited restrictions reserve rightMarginalValue for positive states and zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal for the economic boundary.

Canonical compact support proves asset integrability. The decomposition uses integral_sub with that proof and integrability of the constant shift under a probability law. Totalized integrals are not mistaken for finite expectations; the repair introduces no ENNReal-to-Real conversion.

Weak continuity is used only against a globally bounded continuous clipped policy. Common compact support makes clipping exact, while uniform policy convergence controls the varying integrand. This proves stationary mean continuity, not total-variation continuity or moments from arbitrary initial laws.

Strict impatience is exactly the assigned restriction encoded in ImpatientPrices. No positive consumption, positive minimum effective income, labor-mean normalization or assumed finite moments are added.
The new proof uses integral decomposition and continuity composition only. Controller checks report no sorry or prohibited shortcuts across 519 audited declarations.
The new export's parsed transitive axioms and the 519-declaration union contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; both theorem probes print axioms.
The sole new export matches its elaborated product-domain signature. Both probes check the unchanged anchor; the new theorem has #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms in both audit files.
